name: Cittern
source: The Grand Master of the Holy Order of Knights. In addition to defending the borders of the Hierophant's lands, she and her knights are also tasked with enforcing the rule of law in the land, and she is very strict when it comes to the Commandments of the god Mithras. Her Arcana is Justice.
translation: The Grand Master of the Holy Order of Knights. In addition to defending the borders of the Hierophant's lands, she and her knights are also tasked with enforcing the rule of law in the land, and she is very strict when it comes to the Commandments of the god Mithras. Her Arcana is Justice.
